name: Perimeter
summary: The starter zone: wide exterior terrain and industrial infrastructure with open navigation and beginner-friendly encounters. Learn the loop here before the marshes punish you.

pois.name: Command Hub
pois.note: Highest loot density on the map. High risk — experienced squads rotate here first.

pois.name: Data Wall
pois.note: Industrial POI on the western approach.

pois.name: The Hauler
pois.note: Wrecked transport — mid-tier containers, decent early-route stop.

pois.name: Twin Relays
pois.note: Paired relay structures; good contract objective coverage.

pois.name: Exfil window (rotating)
pois.note: Extraction points open during limited windows — reach them before the timer closes; expect convergence.

tips: Exfil windows are timed and contested: plan your route to arrive early, not exactly on time.
Command Hub money is real but so is the third-party traffic — hit it only with a full crew or skip it solo.

name: Dire Marsh
summary: Dense swamp with toxic hazards and frequent PvP. The best zone for crafting materials, research data, and faction contracts — ideal for mid-level progression.

pois.name: AI Uplink
pois.note: Some of the best loot on the map. Locked Room to the east connects to the main complex.

pois.name: Locked Room (East)
pois.note: Key-gated room connecting to the main complex.

pois.name: Secured Resources
pois.note: Inside the central outpost — crafting material concentration.

pois.name: Toxic bogs (hazard)
pois.note: Environmental damage zones — Hazard Tolerance (NuCaloric) reduces the pain.

pois.name: Exfil window (rotating)
pois.note: Timed extraction; marsh sightlines make the final approach dangerous.

tips: This is the contract zone: stack faction contracts that share POIs before deploying.
Toxic hazards drain you slowly — carry one more patch kit than you think you need.

name: Outpost
summary: A UESC military facility built around the Pinwheel — a vertical combat structure where squads fight over high-tier loot and clearance-controlled areas.

pois.name: The Pinwheel
pois.note: Central vertical combat zone; high-tier loot and clearance-controlled areas. The whole map rotates around it.

pois.name: Clearance-controlled wings
pois.note: Gated rooms requiring clearance — bring keys/clearance or a Thief grapple line.

pois.name: UESC garrison posts
pois.note: Heavier UESC presence than the marsh zones.

pois.name: Exfil window (rotating)
pois.note: Fewer squads (12 players) but they're all good. Exfil fights here are decisive.

tips: Verticality wins the Pinwheel: Thief's grapple and Vandal's Microjets are disproportionately strong here.
12-player lobbies mean quieter rotations — sound discipline matters more, not less.

name: Night Marsh
summary: Season 2's headline zone: Dire Marsh plunged into darkness with new mechanics, new combatants, and new locations — a horror-tinged take on the marsh.

pois.name: Darkness (global)
pois.note: Low visibility changes every engagement rule from the day marsh.

pois.name: AI Uplink (night)
pois.note: Same anchor POI as Dire Marsh — contested in the dark.

pois.name: New locations
pois.note: Season 2 adds locations to explore; community mapping in progress.

pois.name: Exfil window (rotating)
pois.note: Light discipline at exfil is everything — muzzle flash is a beacon.

tips: Recon's Echo Pulse and Sentinel's Prey Tracker substitute for the eyes the darkness takes away.
New combatant types patrol at night — assume any silhouette is hostile until pinged.

name: Cryo Archive
summary: The endgame zone: a hub-and-spoke 'bicycle wheel' layout with Control and Panopticon at the center and six wings radiating out. Security Clearance Level 3 is required to exfil.

pois.name: Control
pois.note: Central POI. Exfil Stations tend to be found near and within Control.

pois.name: Panopticon
pois.note: Second central POI sharing the hub.

pois.name: Cargo (wing)
pois.note: Spawn wing — runs start at the outer end of a wing.

pois.name: Steerage (wing)
pois.note: Spawn wing.

pois.name: Biostock (wing)
pois.note: Spawn wing.

pois.name: Preservation (wing)
pois.note: Spawn wing.

pois.name: Revival (wing)
pois.note: Spawn wing.

pois.name: Index (wing)
pois.note: Spawn wing.

tips: See the full endgame guide for clearance routing, the Compiler, and lockdown traps.
